# telnyx_storage_kv_namespaces (Data Source)

Lists storage kv namespaces, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_storage_kv_namespace`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `storage_kv_namespaces` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_kv_namespaces))

<a id="nestedatt--storage_kv_namespaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_kv_namespaces`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `record_type` (String)
- `status` (String) Provisioning status. A namespace is usable once `status` is `provision_ok`. Once deletion completes, the namespace no longer appears in the API.
- `updated_at` (String)
